title: Combinatorics of degeneracy in vertical systems
summary: We characterize the generic consistency of vertical systems in terms of the iterated circuits of the column matroid of the coefficient matrix. More precisely, we prove that such a system is generically consistent if and only if there exists an iterated circuit such that the dimension of the Minkowski sum of the associated Newton polytopes is equal to the rank of the coefficient matrix. We also give an equivalent characterization in terms of $G$-spanning flags of the dual matroid.
